reviews.comment: i love her! super easy exams if you just study the slides. she had a 20 point bonus question to the final as well! the final is weighed the same as the two midterms. discussion posts/reading once or twice a week but not bad at all. shes very nice and has interesting comparisons to her own life/research when lecturing. overall easy A

Go to class and study the slides well before exams. The exams are not hard if you study. For our final exam, she gave 20 bonus points for a written question. I had a disability, and she was very kind and accommodating. Overall, great class! She also has good style lol

She's nice, the class is really easy and so are the exams. She does have a participation grade that's taken from either in class online questions or a group discussion (they're really chill). The dates those happen are on syllabus but don't always follow it.
